description: Creates a device (CPU/HMI/IO) by typeIdentifier. Optional group is an existing device user-group path (Area/Line, case-insensitive); omitted means project level. For group, GET /status must advertise supportsDeviceGroupCreation:true (app 1.8.1+); older serves are refused before creation. Uses typed CreateWithItem, never the unsafe generic CreateDevices call. The successful receipt identifies the canonical group; missing or different placement is an error naming the created station when available: inspect before retrying, never retry automatically. A dryRun preview does not check serve support. The answer uses the station type identifier, falling back to the first readable DeviceItem.TypeIdentifier, including HMI panels. typeIdentifierSource is device, deviceItem or unavailable; unavailable metadata has typeIdentifier:null and an explicit typeIdentifierUnavailableReason. For a single-item device such as a Classic panel, set its name as deviceItemName and omit deviceName; deviceName is the station name and may be read-only. On 400 device_name_read_only, re-read GET /devices before retrying with only deviceItemName. Guard Gd5: '/V<fw>' (slash), never ':V' — resolve via tia_catalog. Maps to POST /devices. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

deviceItemName.description: device-item name; for an HMI, names the panel item (for a single-item device, use this as its name)

deviceName.description: station name; may be read-only on some device types

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

group.description: existing device user-group path from the project root, e.g. Area/Line; omitted: project level (app 1.8.1+)
